faq.question: How much does window replacement cost in Cotati?
faq.answer: Cotati homeowners typically invest $4,000 to $8,500 for a full window replacement project. This small Sonoma County city features modest 1960s–1980s homes with standard window sizing. Projects typically cover 8–12 windows. Single window installation starts at approximately $400.

faq.question: Do I need a permit for window replacement in Cotati?
faq.answer: Yes. Cotati requires a building permit for window replacements. Our team manages all permit applications with the City of Cotati Building Department on your behalf.

faq.question: Which window brands does Deluxe Windows install in Cotati?
faq.answer: For Cotati's suburban Sonoma housing stock, we most frequently install Milgard Tuscany vinyl for its excellent value, Simonton for budget-conscious whole-home replacements, and Anlin Del Mar for energy-conscious homeowners looking to reduce heating and cooling costs.

faq.question: Does Deluxe Windows serve all Cotati neighborhoods?
faq.answer: Yes — we serve all of Cotati including the City Center area, East Cotati, and all surrounding residential neighborhoods. Zip code: 94931.

faq.question: How long does window replacement take in Cotati?
faq.answer: Most Cotati projects are measured in one visit and installed in one to three working days once windows arrive, typically four to eight weeks after ordering.
